text:
Maya: Quick run 52 post-launch prioritization for Acme renewal. They want two small fixes + a stability guarantee. We need owners, timeboxes, and a gating plan.

Priya: TL;DR from CS: (1) live-stream dropouts on long responses (Acme) 100% priority, (2) token-truncation fallback for >4k prompts (Beta corp) medium, (3) confusing label on embeddings export (UI) low.

Tomas: Can we apply a simple triage rubric: severity (customer-facing hit + revenue risk), reproducibility, and rollout complexity. Anything scoring >=7 (out of 10) becomes sprint A blocker.

Jordan: Proposal for scoring: severity (1-5), repro (1-3), rollout risk (1-2). Stream dropout: 5+3+2=10 -> immediate. Token truncation: 3+2+1=6 -> next sprint unless Beta threatens. UI label: 1+1+1=3 -> backlog.

Erin: From infra: stream dropout seems correlated with high-kv-cache churn on a subset of dedicated hosts. We should reserve a hotfix lane: 1 engineer for immediate triage + 1 for rollback/mitigation. Also recommend canary window of 30 minutes with synthetic load.

Maya: Suggested plan: Sprint A (4 business days):
```
- Stream incident hotfix (owner: Tomas)  estimate: 2d triage + 1d canary roll + 1d follow-up (total 4d)
- Token truncation UX + backend guard (owner: Jordan)  estimate: 2d UX + 2d backend = 4d (defer if conflicting)
- Embeddings label microfix (owner: Erin)  estimate: 0.5d, behind feature flag
```
Put the stream fix in front. If hotfix work uncovers infra codepath regression, escalate and pause other non-blocking work.

Priya: Can we also commit a customer-facing message template and a one-hour demo/validation session after canary for Acme? They need assurance for renewal.

Tomas: I'll open a ticket: PROD-ACME-1234 with label `postlaunch-commit` and link incident logs. I'll also add acceptance criteria: reproduce locally, <0.3% dropout on canary under synthetic load, incremental rollout plan.

Jordan: I'll push a server-side guard that rejects requests >8k tokens with clear SDK error and Console warning. Also add a short-term SDK client-side check.

Erin: Embeddings label PR ready. I'll include doc links and changelog entry.

Maya: Release gating checklist (draft):
- Canary window: 30m synthetic traffic + customer shadowing
- Success metric: error/dropout rate <=0.3% and no spike in latencies (>95th p95)
- Rollback if any 5xx or connection closures >0.5% or if customer reports failure
- Post-canary wait: 2 hours before regional rollout unless Acme signs off

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 1749221300. Will stream health and error-rate every 5m.

Priya: I'll prepare the customer communication and draft the demo script. Maya, can you own scheduling demo with Acme once deploy-bot shows green?

Maya: Yes. I'll block time and invite product + CS + the engineer owner.

Jordan: Small ask: can we add a CI smoke test that runs an end-to-end long-stream scenario with a mocked backend? If it fails, block merges to main for that week.

Tomas: Good idea. I'll add a lightweight test and a runbook for oncall. Also tagging Ops for a hotfix rotation.

Maya: OK all. Action items:
- Tomas: ticket + triage (due EOD tomorrow)
- Jordan: SDK + backend guard PR (in 2 days)
- Erin: UI label PR (today)
- Priya: customer comms + demo script (tomorrow)
- Maya: schedule demo after canary green

Maya: We'll reconvene tomorrow 9:30am to check progress and canary metrics. Keep updates in the ticket thread and slap `postlaunch-commit` label. :thumbsup:
